entities.name: Ms. Skiffle
entities.description: A teacher in Bablovia who runs a class of oral projects on the government.

entities.name: Martina
entities.description: A cynical student who presents on the Carta Scientia.

entities.name: Anabelle
entities.description: A student who presents on the structure of the Bablovian meta-government and would like to join the League of Dastardly Doom.

entities.name: Kareem
entities.description: A student who tells the story of the founding of the Order of the Widget.

entities.name: Juanita
entities.description: A student who presents on the Agents of S.N.E.A.K.

entities.name: Harold
entities.description: A student who presents on the League of Dastardly Doom.

entities.name: Ming-na
entities.description: A student who presents on the Goblin Explosioneers.

entities.name: Nadima
entities.description: A student who presents on the Crossbreed Labs.

entities.name: Stewart
entities.description: A student who ignores his assigned topic to claim squirrels secretly run Bablovia.

entities.name: Grand Calcutron
entities.description: The machine-bodied founder and leader of the Order of the Widget, formerly the inventor Calvin Granderson.

entities.name: Phoebe
entities.description: The self-proclaimed current leader of the Agents of S.N.E.A.K.

entities.name: X
entities.description: A shadowy figure paid by various sources to steal the Golden Ruler.

entities.name: Ol' Buzzbark
entities.description: The current alpha goblin of the Goblin Explosioneers.

entities.name: Dr. Julius Jumblemorph
entities.description: A scientist who perfected genetic splicing and heads the Crossbreed Labs.

entities.name: Dr. Luisa Rodriguez
entities.description: A scientist who worked with Jameson on a cancer cure.

entities.name: Dr. Hana Tanaka
entities.description: A scientist who worked with Jameson on a cancer cure.

entities.name: Major Monologue
entities.description: A would-be supervillain whose support group became the League of Dastardly Doom.

entities.name: Thorna Grabbler
entities.description: The head of Steamflogger Industries who recruited the goblins and formed the Goblin Explosioneers.

entities.name: Baron Von Count
entities.description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

entities.name: The Big Idea
entities.description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

entities.name: Grusilda
entities.description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

entities.name: Mary O'Kill
entities.description: A member of the Legion of Evil.

entities.name: Dr. Malevolence
entities.description: A supervillain for whom Harold plans to build a freeze ray.

entities.name: Bablovia
entities.description: A science-obsessed world governed by a pentarchy of five factions.

entities.name: Carta Scientia
entities.description: The oldest document in Bablovia, which lets sciences form their own governments.

entities.name: Order of the Widget
entities.description: A technocracy led by the Grand Calcutron whose members upgrade their bodies with technology.

entities.name: Agents of S.N.E.A.K.
entities.description: A kleptocracy of spies that began as a job board and does not know its own purpose.

entities.name: League of Dastardly Doom
entities.description: An oligarchy of supervillains ruled by a cabal, which licenses supervillainy.

entities.name: Goblin Explosioneers
entities.description: A goblin faction with a chaotic government that took over Steamflogger Industries.

entities.name: Crossbreed Labs
entities.description: A geniocracy that alters people into their animal true forms.

entities.name: Legion of Evil
entities.description: The cabal that currently rules the League of Dastardly Doom.

entities.name: Society of Vile
entities.description: A former ruling cabal of the League.

entities.name: Clan of Cruelty
entities.description: A former ruling cabal of the League which blackmailed the other factions with a weather machine.

entities.name: Men of Malice
entities.description: The first ruling cabal of the League, originally a subgroup about poor trap planning.

entities.name: Steamflogger Industries
entities.description: A steel mill company taken over by goblins.

entities.name: Golden Ruler
entities.description: The object whose possessor leads the Agents of S.N.E.A.K.

entities.name: Port Gizmo
entities.description: A lovely place Calvin visited on a day trip.

events.summary: Ms. Skiffle opens the first day of oral projects on Bablovian government.
events.quote: Today's the first day for our oral projects.

events.summary: Martina presents on the Carta Scientia and editorializes against Bablovia's governments.
events.quote: It's the oldest document in all of Bablovia.

events.summary: Anabelle explains that Bablovia is a pentarchy of five organizations.
events.quote: Bablovia is currently what is known as a pentarchy.

events.summary: Anabelle explains the Order of the Widget is led by the machine Grand Calcutron.
events.quote: Their leader is the Grand Calcutron, a machine that runs the Order with absolute authority.

events.summary: Anabelle explains that leadership of S.N.E.A.K. goes to whoever holds the Golden Ruler, now Phoebe.
events.quote: Their current leader, as of last week, is Phoebe, the self-proclaimed Head of S.N.E.A.K.

events.summary: Anabelle describes the League's ruling Legion of Evil and its predecessor cabals.
events.quote: The group that currently controls the League is a cabal known as the Legion of Evil.

events.summary: Anabelle describes the Goblin Explosioneers' chaotic rule under Ol' Buzzbark.
events.quote: is named Ol' Buzzbark.

events.summary: Anabelle names Dr. Julius Jumblemorph as head of the Crossbreed Labs.
events.quote: The current head of the Crossbreed Labs is Dr. Julius Jumblemorph.

events.summary: Anabelle recounts that the League, led by the Clan of Cruelty, once blackmailed the other factions with a weather machine to change the law.
events.quote: the League of Dastardly Doom, led by the Clan of Cruelty, blackmailed the other factions with a weather machine.

events.summary: Kareem tells how Calvin Granderson founded the Order of the Widget.
events.quote: The organization was founded 54 years ago by a man named Calvin Granderson.

events.summary: Craving toast on vacation, Calvin replaces his left hand with a toaster (flashback).
events.quote: he replaced his left hand with a toaster.

events.summary: Calvin forms the Order of the Widget to support those following his self-upgrade movement.
events.quote: He formed the Order of the Widget as a means to give support to the large number of people who embraced this new self-help ideology.

events.summary: Calvin becomes the machine known as the Grand Calcutron after replacing most of his body.
events.quote: Calvin Granderson became Calcutron Granderson and eventually the Grand Calcutron.

events.summary: Juanita reports that no S.N.E.A.K. agent she interviewed knows its agenda.
events.quote: I talked to 34 agents for my report. No one knows.

events.summary: Juanita explains S.N.E.A.K. began as a job board that turned into the center of organized crime.
events.quote: The Agents of S.N.E.A.K. started out as a job-share board.

events.summary: Harold explains that the League began as a supervillain support group started by Major Monologue.
events.quote: It started, interestingly, as a supervillain support group.

events.summary: The poor-trap-planning subgroup becomes the Men of Malice, the first step toward an official organization.
events.quote: One subgroup, poor trap planning, ended up becoming the Men of Malice

events.summary: Ming-na tells of Steamflogger Industries, a steel mill, and its recruitment of goblins.
events.quote: It all started years ago with Steamflogger Industries.

events.summary: Thorna Grabbler lures a goblin clan to work in the factory with hammers and technology (flashback).
events.quote: The entire clan of goblins chose to come work in the factory.

events.summary: Thorna forms the Goblin Explosioneers as a political faction.
events.quote: She let the goblins choose the name and ended up with the Goblin Explosioneers.

events.summary: The goblins take over Steamflogger Industries as workers, management and finally Thorna leave.
events.quote: The goblins had taken over Steamflogger Industries.

events.summary: Nadima tells how three scientists seeking a cancer cure accidentally grew a tail on a subject.
events.quote: Instead, the subject grew a tail.

events.summary: Dr. Jameson gives himself wings and opens the procedure to students.
events.quote: Dr. Jameson undertook the procedure to get a pair of wings.

events.summary: Dr. Jameson adds dinosaur DNA and renames himself Dr. Julius Jumblemorph.
events.quote: After he mixed in dinosaur DNA, he chose to change his name and became Dr. Julius Jumblemorph.

events.summary: Jumblemorph wins over politicians to make the Crossbreed Labs its own government.
events.quote: Dr. Jumblemorph convinced a few politicians to help him after allowing them to find their true selves.

events.summary: Stewart relates that white mice went extinct from overuse in experiments.
events.quote: In the end, the last white mouse died thirteen years ago.

events.summary: Stewart claims the Crossbreed Labs improved squirrels as replacement subjects and that squirrels secretly run all five factions.
events.quote: I believe all five factions are secretly being run by the squirrels.

events.summary: Ms. Skiffle ends the class.
events.quote: Class dismissed!
